meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把一份文档变成 kawaii 风格的 NotebookLM 幻灯片 PDF，存在源文件旁边；若配好环境变量，还会上传并返回可在手机看的分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「wowerpoint 这个文件」「把这份报告做成幻灯片」等，或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的分页幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 report.md 做成幻灯片 PDF
say.note: 在源文件旁生成 <文件名>-slides.pdf

say.text: 把这份季度报告做成 kawaii 幻灯片
say.note: 用默认那一句提示词生成

say.text: 做幻灯片，提示词就用：用可爱角色讲这个故事
say.note: 你给的提示词原文照传，不加改

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a single document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF saved beside the source file, and, if server env vars are set, uploads it to return a mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", or any ask to render one document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.text: Wowerpoint this: turn report.md into a slide-deck PDF
Turn this report into kawaii slides
Make a deck with this prompt: warm and clear
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim
